figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. Effect of compound 1 on IAV. (a) IAV (100TCID50) infected MDCK cells were treated with MWS at three conditions with different concentrations for 24 h, 
then the antiviral activity was tested by CPE inhibition assay. i) Pretreatment of virus: PR8 was pretreated with different concentrations of compound 1 at 37 ◦C for 1 
h before infection. ii) adsorption: MDCK cells were infected by the mixture of IAV and different concentrations of compound 1, after 1 h of adsorption at 37 ◦C, 
compound-free media was added to the well. iii) Post-adsorption: After infecting MDCK cells with PR8 for 1 h, different concentrations of compound 1 were added to 
the well. Values were means ± SD (n = 3). (b) PR8 infected MDCK cells were treated with or without 20 μM compound 1 for the specified time period, and then the 
media was removed and cells were overlaid with 1640 media without compound 1. The virus titers in the cell supernatant were evaluated by HA assay. Values were 
means ± SD (n = 3). Significance: *p < 0.05 vs. PR8 group, **p < 0.01 vs. PR8 group. (c) The inhibition effects of compound 1 and anti-HA antibody on PR8 induced 
aggregation of cRBCs were assessed by HI assay. (d) Neuraminidase inhibition activity of compound 1.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 6. The effect of compound 1 on viral NP protein expression. (a) MDCK cells were infected with PR8 at a MOI of 1.0 at 37 ◦C for 1 h, and then treated with or 
without 10–40 μM compound 1. At 4 h p.i., the virus NP protein expression was determined by western blot. GAPDH was also detected as control. (b) The relative 
protein level of NP protein. The ratio for non-drug treated virus control group (PR8) was assigned values of 1.0 and the data presented as mean ± SD (n = 3). 
Significance: *P < 0.05 vs virus control group (PR8), **P < 0.01 vs virus control group (PR8). (c) Confocal imaging of virus NP in PR8 infected MDCK cells at 4 h p.i. 
Scale bar represents 20 μm.
